recordSet.description: Station metadata distributed by Hub’Eau through its hydrometry and river-temperature services (https://hubeau.eaufrance.fr/), used under the Etalab Open Licence (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Hub’Eau distributes data from several producers; its role does not establish the original producer of every record. Source acquisition identities and dates remain in the catalogue provenance; acquisition dates are not asserted to be publisher last-update dates. RivRetrieve selected the declared source fields and encoded their values and absence states; source names remain unchanged. Processing and publication of this projection: RivRetrieve.
